headline: OECD Scrutinizes Consumer Protection Efforts in RI Starting Next Month
summary: The OECD will begin reviewing the overall consumer protection ecosystem in Indonesia next month, according to the source.
why: The OECD is an international economic policy body, and its reviews influence regulatory standards that investors watch in emerging markets.
original_headline: OECD Pelototi Upaya Pelindungan Konsumen di RI Mulai Bulan Depan
